description: Use when testing whether augmenting a sparse or artificially downsampled cell population (e.g. PBMC cluster 2 at retention levels from 50% to 0.5%) improves classifier performance relative to downsampled or randomly duplicated baselines.

name: classifier-f1-score-evaluation
description: Use when you need to quantify single-cell annotation accuracy of classifiers trained on actively selected labeled cells, comparing strategies (e.g., marker-ranked vs random initial selection) via F1-score per stratified split.

name: classifier-metric-evaluation
description: Use when comparing marker selection methods by cell type classification performance across a sweep of marker counts k (e.g. accuracy-vs-k curves on scRNA-seq data like Zeisel), especially to test performance in the low-marker regime.

name: classifier-metric-evaluation-ap-precision-recall
description: Use when a trained binary classifier must be scored on held-out labels and compared across ablated feature-set conditions (e.g., multi-omics vs DNA-only vs RNA-only) using AP, precision, recall, and F-measure.

name: classifier-performance-metrics-evaluation
description: Use when you have per-cell predicted labels (cancer/non_cancer) plus publication ground-truth annotations for one or more scRNA-seq test sets and need to reproduce or compare the paper's five reported metrics.

name: classifier-probability-threshold-evaluation
description: Use when you have gold-standard labeled scRNA-seq data (e.g. test_cancerCellLine.h5ad, test_TabulaSapiens.h5ad) and need to quantify a classifier's sensitivity on malignant cells and specificity on normal epithelial cells against published benchmarks.

name: classifier-uncertainty-estimation-entropy-maxprob
description: Use when running an active learning loop for single-cell type annotation where you must decide which unlabeled cells (e.g., next 10 of many predicted on first 20 PCs) an expert should label next, using entropy or max-probability uncertainty from caret-trained RF/LR classifiers.

name: cleavage-site-genomic-interval-intersection
description: Use when you have de novo-called scRNA-seq cleavage site coordinates and need to classify them as GENCODE-validated, externally supported (PolyASite), or novel by genomic interval overlap.

name: cleavage-site-peak-calling-per-cell-type
description: Use when the goal is to map 3' end cleavage sites de novo from MWS reads spanning the poly(A) tail per cell type, e.g. building a CS atlas from the Mouse Cell Atlas or Human Cell Landscape.

name: clinical-concordance-correlation-analysis
description: Use when a computational IGHV mutation classifier's calls must be validated against clinical Sanger-based mCLL/uCLL labels, to quantify concordance and correlation of percent-mutation values in a CLL RNA-seq cohort.

name: clinical-covariate-adjustment-regression
description: Use when associating continuous molecular scores (e.g., PROGENy pathway activity) with patient overall survival time and event status, and confounders such as cohort/study of origin or age must be adjusted for.

name: clinical-outcome-prediction-modeling
description: Use when training data and external validation data come from different transcriptomic platforms (e.g., RNA-seq vs. microarray GEO datasets) and the goal is a clinical outcome prediction model that transfers across platforms.

name: clinical-phenotype-association-testing
description: Use when a merged, edge-pruned SCING GRN and snRNAseq matrix with per-cell clinical metadata (diagnosis, plaque stage, tangle stage, sex) are available and the goal is to test which GRN modules are significantly associated with disease traits.

name: clinical-survival-data-integration
description: Use when detected RNCs/modules from tumor expression data (e.g., 161 TCGA ESCA tumors) must be associated with clinical survival outcomes, requiring a per-module Kaplan-Meier log-rank statistic.

name: clinical-trial-binary-outcome-count-analysis
description: Use when phase I/II trial data contain per-dose binary toxicity (DLT) and efficacy outcome counts (x_jkl) plus isotonic DLT rate estimates from PAVA, and closed-form joint response probability estimates are needed to feed a utility-based OBD selection.

name: clinical-trial-monte-carlo-simulation
description: Use when estimating operating characteristics — early-termination probability, dose-selection percentages P1/P2 — of the TSNP design for a given toxicity/efficacy scenario, such as the null (all doses overly toxic, φ=0.2) case.

name: clinical-trial-toxicity-data-processing
description: Use when you have per-dose phase I/II toxicity data (patient counts n_j and DLT counts) whose raw proportions p̃_j violate the order constraint p1 ≤ p2 ≤ ... ≤ pJ and you need monotonicity-constrained DLT rate estimates for dose-escalation decisions or utility calculations.

name: clinical-trial-treatment-response-modeling
description: Use when modeling treatment response in a clinical or trial-like dataset where the goal is subgroup identification (e.

name: clinvar-pfam-annotation-mapping
description: Use when RNA-seq isoform usage comparison yields isoform switching/dMDT events and each event must be annotated with ClinVar disease-gene status and PFAM domain IDs to score functional impact on protein interactions.

name: clinvar-variant-gene-mapping
description: Use when you have ClinVar VUSs prioritized by a splicing predictor (e.g., SpliceAI) and per-gene MRSD scores (.results.mrsd.txt) from whole blood, LCL, skeletal muscle, and cultured fibroblast GTEx datasets, and need the fraction of variants in low-MRSD (assayable) genes.

name: clinvar-variant-significance-filtering
description: Use when the goal is to extract a bounded, clinically interpretable set of predicted splice-altering variants from ClinVar as the input cohort for RNA-seq splicing analyses such as MRSD scoring.

name: clip-database-rbp-list-overlap-analysis
description: Use when a candidate regulator list (e.g., genes from an NMF cluster enriched in gold regulators) must be checked for significant over-representation of experimentally determined circRNA-binding RBPs from CLIP-derived resources like POSTAR3 or ENCORI.

name: clipped-read-gaussian-likelihood-modeling
description: Use when ATAC-Seq junction evidence (discordant read pairs plus soft-clipped/supplementary-aligned reads) must be converted into an exact ecDNA breakpoint posterior, e.g. to quantify how 95% CI width scales with read length down to 35 bp.

name: clock-controlled-gene-overlap-analysis
description: Use when you have a called cycler gene set (e.g., Tempo de novo cyclers per cell type) and want to test its overlap with a reference gene set (clock genes or bulk JTKCycle q<0.05 cyclers) with empirical p-values.

name: clonal-assignment-concordance-evaluation
description: Use when quantifying how clonal assignments from mtDNA variants hold up under reduced sequencing depth — e.g., comparing vireoSNP clone labels at downsampled mt-read depths against full-depth labels on 10x scDNA/scRNA BAMs.

name: clonal-assignment-variational-inference
description: Use when a SNP-by-cell matrix of mitochondrial alternate-allele depths (AD) and total depths (DP) is available with MQuad-selected informative mtDNA variants, and cells must be partitioned into clonal populations.

name: clonal-configuration-error-evaluation
description: Use when benchmarking clonal-inference methods on simulated multi-sample bulk DNA WES plus scRNA-seq data and you need a permutation-invariant reconstruction error for the Z and P^s configuration matrices.

name: clonal-diversity-index-computation
description: Use when a normalized barcode counts table (e.g. counts/all_counts_combined.tsv) is available and the goal is to test whether drug treatments (e.g. DMSO, IBET-151, AraC) or dose-escalation time courses differ in clonal composition or diversity.

name: clonal-expansion-fraction-quantification
description: Use when paired single-cell transcriptome + full-length TCR data are available (e.g. >3500 CD8 TILs from seven B16 melanoma mice, GEO GSE116390) and the goal is to test whether distinct CD8 TIL states share overlapping TCR clonotypes.

name: clonal-phylogeny-interpretation
description: Use when a single-sample scRNA-seq tumor count matrix must be resolved into malignant subclones with truncal vs shared vs subclone-specific copy-number alterations and a clone phylogeny, as in glioblastoma samples from GSE131928.

name: clonal-prevalence-estimation
description: Use when paired scDNA-seq CNA and scRNA-seq expression matrices with ground-truth DNA clone labels are available and the goal is to assess whether a cell-to-clone integration method's predicted clonal prevalences correlate with ground truth.

name: clonal-reassignment-visualization
description: Use when single-cell RNA-seq data carry linked genotype (GoT) calls for somatic mutations (e.g., WT, SF3B1, SF3B1-CALR, SF3B1-CALR-NFE2 clones) and conflicting cluster annotations must be reconciled to reassign cells to transcriptionally consistent clonal populations.

name: clonal-tree-inference-mtdna-variants
description: Use when analysis-ready single-cell RNA/DNA/ATAC-seq BAM files are available and the goal is to call clone-discriminative mtDNA variants and assign cells to mitochondrial clones or subclones within nuclear-inferred clones.

name: clonal-variant-caller-benchmarking
description: Decision support for choosing an mtDNA variant caller for scRNA-seq clonality analysis, or for reproducing a simulation-based benchmark comparing MQuad, mgatk, and Monovar on ground-truth clonal variants.

name: clonal-weighted-hybrid-clustering
description: Use when single-cell count data have paired clone-barcode assignments (cell ID to barcode table) and the goal is to test how weighting clonal origin reshapes transcriptome-only clusters, e.g. reducing entropy of known cell-type distributions across clusters.

name: clone-assignment-cell-grouping
description: Use when single-cell RNA-seq data from a tumour sample must be partitioned into malignant subclones and normal cells based on copy number alterations, e.g., before clone-stratified differential expression.

name: clone-barcode-transcriptome-hybrid-clustering
description: Use when single-cell count matrices are paired with clone-barcode assignments and you need clusters that weigh clonal origin alongside transcriptomic similarity, plus verification that cluster markers keep ROC AUC fidelity across α levels.

name: clone-barcode-weight-matrix-normalization
description: Use when you have a two-column cell-ID-to-barcode table (e.g. columns 'rn' and 'Barcode') and need to convert clonal relationships into normalized edge weights for graph-based single-cell clustering or integration with a transcriptome SNN graph.

name: clone-barcode-weighted-louvain-clustering
description: Use when single-cell transcriptome data has paired clone barcode assignments and you want hybrid clusters weighting clonal origin against transcriptomic similarity, e.g. barcoded melanoma/iPSC/HSC datasets.

name: clone-cnv-concordance-analysis
description: Use when you have mtDNA clone assignments (e.g., MQuad/vireoSNP output with cell-level clone labels) plus independent annotations such as CNV subclones or tumor/normal labels, and need to test whether the mitochondrial clones recapitulate or refine the known clonal structure.

name: clone-informed-pc-warping
description: Use when you have a PCA (or similar reduced-dimension) matrix plus per-cell clone barcode assignments and want a UMAP-style 2D visualization in which cells sharing a barcode coalesce as a single tunable parameter s increases.

name: clone-size-correlation-analysis
description: Use when two lineage barcoding pre-processing pipelines must be cross-validated on identical single-cell amplicon FASTQ data and agreement should be quantified by per-cell annotation overlap and clone-size correlation.

name: closed-pattern-discovery-in-snp-data
description: Use when mining significant higher-order combinations of SNPs (genetic meta-markers) across interacting genes, given binary or additive-encoded marker matrices, phenotype labels, a covariate, and a PPI/pathway/complex prior network.

name: clr-normalization-of-adt-counts
description: Use when a protein/ADT count matrix from CITE-seq or related assays must be normalized as a baseline (e.g., benchmarking against dsb), by applying CLR across cells.

name: clr-protein-count-normalization
description: Use when normalizing droplet-based protein (ADT) counts from CITE-seq/TEA-seq data and you need a standard baseline normalization against which background-corrected methods like dsb can be compared, or when empty-droplet background matrices are not being modeled.

name: cluster-agreement-metrics-computation
description: Use when you have two or more categorical cell-annotation columns over the same cells (e.g. scTriangulate labels vs. HLCA/CellRef label-transfer results) and need an external-agreement benchmark to compare integration strategies.

name: cluster-annotation-against-known-attributes
description: Use when an RCC (or other unsupervised) clustering result must be cross-tabulated with known sample attributes—such as the Biase dataset's ICM vs. trophectoderm labels—to biologically interpret and validate the clusters.

name: cluster-annotation-confusion-analysis
description: Use when you have a cell-wise (sample-wise) optimal EMBEDR embedding plus expert cell-type annotations and need to test whether unsupervised cluster structure in the embedding is biologically concordant with those annotations.

name: cluster-annotation-consistency-assessment
description: Use when evaluating whether one-against-all cluster marker gene identification produces pseudo marker genes and how many clusters an automatic annotator (scCATCH/CellMatch) labels consistently with manual ground-truth labels on a clustered scRNA-seq dataset.

name: cluster-assignment-accuracy-verification
description: Use when you have simulated single-cell count data with known per-cell-type/DE-group ground-truth labels and need to verify that feature profiles adhere to expected mean cluster profiles before benchmarking downstream methods.

name: cluster-assignment-error-rate-evaluation
description: Use when comparing cell-clustering accuracy of methods that assign single cells (scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq) to known subpopulations, e.g. testing whether loop data reduces error as dropout increases.

name: cluster-assignment-survival-association
description: Use when you have per-sample cluster assignments plus clinical survival data (survival time and cancer-type attribute) and need to quantify how many cancer types have subtypes with significantly distinct survival profiles.

name: cluster-assignment-tabulation
description: Use when sample-wise tncRNA profiles (Supplementary sheets 5.1–5.4) must be reduced with t-SNE to 2D and each tissue sample assigned to its nearest cluster and logged in a tabular record.

name: cluster-attribute-enrichment-annotation
description: Use when RCC_clus has produced recursive consensus cluster assignments and you must validate clusters against sample metadata (attribute columns with a minSample cutoff) or assign subtype labels to clusters.

name: cluster-based-adaptive-reweighting-sampling
description: Use when constructing a labeled training set from a single-cell expression dataset (Seurat object with log-normalized expression) where rare cell types must be captured and active learning is impractical or no iterative labeling budget exists.

name: cluster-based-malignant-cell-refinement
description: Use when scATOMIC has annotated cells as cancer at the terminal layer but normal cells from the cancer's tissue of origin may be present in the tumour biopsy and must be distinguished from true malignant cells.

name: cluster-based-minimum-spanning-tree-inference
description: Use when you have clustering assignments for single-cell data plus a low-dimensional cell embedding and need to build the tree-shaped trajectory backbone (MST over clusters) for topology estimation, as in Totem's cell-connectivity-guided trajectory inference.

name: cluster-basis-cell-type-reassignment
description: Use when a marker-count-based identification run leaves many cells unassigned after rejection, and you want to reassign them cluster-wise before finalizing cell type labels.

name: cluster-celltype-composition-analysis
description: Use when a scRNA-Seq matrix has known cell-type or technical-replicate labels (e.g. LC.PT vs LC.PT_RE) and you need to test whether clusters separate by batch or biology after a correction method (ccRemover, scLVM) has been applied.

name: cluster-centroid-distance-analysis
description: Use when you have an embedded single-cell dataset (e.g., a 20-dim scGAE latent representation) with known cell-type/population labels and need to verify that known transcriptionally related populations (e.g., activated vs quiescent stellate cells, ductal subtypes) remain at short centroid distances.

name: cluster-class-assignment-preprocessing
description: Use when a single-cell expression matrix from a prior clustering step must be paired with per-cell class labels and preprocessed (normalization, correlation transformation, feature selection) before a class-informed 2D embedding.

name: cluster-colocalization-quality-scoring
description: Use when scoring how reproducibly a reference single-cell cluster is reconstructed across multiple SCA clustering runs, or when validating SCA model stability with QCC/QCM against the 0.5 threshold.

name: cluster-connectivity-disconnectedness-evaluation
description: Use when you must decide whether a dimension-reduced embedding (e.g., UMAP, PCA, t-SNE) is suitable as input to trajectory/pseudotime inference in scRNA-seq data, and specifically need to detect clusters that become disconnected or small clusters that group unexpectedly in the embedding.

name: cluster-decomposition-anomaly-detection
description: Use when a cells × genes scRNA-seq count matrix (e.g., the bundled 1%Jurkat.h5 with 1540 293T + 16 Jurkat cells) is suspected to contain rare cell populations that one-time clustering may overlook, and you need rare sub-cluster labels, independence scores, and candidate DE genes.

name: cluster-decomposition-pipeline-execution
description: Use when analyzing a scRNA-seq expression matrix to identify rare cell subpopulations that one-time clustering (PCA + Louvain) may overlook, and you need decomposed/merged sub-clusters with anomaly scores.

name: cluster-edge-direction-correctness-evaluation
description: Use when a spliced/unspliced AnnData with ground-truth cell-type labels has been processed by UniTVelo (or scVelo) and you must validate directionality of specific cluster-to-cluster transitions, e.g. Fev+ to Delta.

name: cluster-enrichment-binomial-testing
description: Use when a cell-attribute aware clustering result (e.g. Eva_partitions output on a kNN graph with a vertex attribute like age) must be scored for which communities are significantly enriched for attribute levels before DA regression.

name: cluster-f1-score-evaluation
description: Use when clusters (possibly from multi-stage scCAN re-clustering) must be quantitatively validated against annotated ground-truth labels for one target cell type, especially rare populations.

name: cluster-graph-topology-verification-across-pc-choices
description: Decision support for whether a trajectory-inference cluster-graph on atlas-scale single-cell data is robust to dimensionality-reduction choices, e.g. verifying VIA topology on MOCA-scale data across varying ncomps before trusting branch and terminal-state structure.

name: cluster-independence-score-computation
description: Use when you already have decomposed/merged M-cluster assignments for a scRNA-seq expression matrix and need per-cluster anomaly scores and rarity calls via isolation-forest anomaly scoring plus the independence score with threshold I=0.7.

name: cluster-interlacement-graph-color-assignment
description: Use when visualizing single-cell spatial (SRT) data where default palettes (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, Giotto) cause perceptual ambiguity between neighboring, biologically distinct cell types that need contrasting colors.

name: cluster-label-based-cell-group-comparison
description: Use when you have final per-cell cluster labels from an scRNA-seq consensus clustering run and need to characterize each cluster biologically via differential expression plus GO/KEGG enrichment.

name: cluster-label-binary-encoding
description: Use when Leiden cluster labels from the scMoMaT post-processed KNN graph (scmomat.post_process + leiden_cluster, e.g. resolution 0.9) must be converted into fixed binary cell factors for the 2nd-stage retraining that yields cluster-specific bio-markers.

name: cluster-label-matching-and-accuracy-scoring
description: Use when evaluating a clustering algorithm's predictions against known ground-truth labels from data generators or annotated datasets, and you need accuracy, NMI, and ARI per method to build a comparison table (e.g. Supplementary Tables S2–S4).

name: cluster-label-to-annotation-correspondence-matching
description: Use when you have cells×genes log-transformed scRNA-seq matrices plus original cell-type annotations and need a numeric measure of how well clusters match the annotations (ARI) to benchmark methods.

name: cluster-level-sensitivity-aggregation
description: Use when scRNA-seq samples from drug-treated and control conditions are clustered (scanpyobj.h5ad) and you need cluster/lineage-level predicted drug sensitivity to compare with observed cell-proportion changes.

name: cluster-marker-characterization
description: Use when a set of candidate rare cells (e.g., 727 FiRE-scored cells from ~20k Arc-ME mouse brain profiles) must be partitioned into subpopulations and assigned cell-type identities via marker genes.

name: cluster-marker-gene-detection
description: Use when a scRNA-seq dataset has already been clustered (e.g. a clustered SCE from the clustering stage) and per-cluster marker genes must be identified, ranked, and reported for each cell grouping.

name: cluster-marker-gene-identification
description: Use when an AnnData object has been processed via the scanpy standard workflow (log-cpm normalised) with tentative cluster labels (e.g. 'leiden') and per-cluster marker genes are needed for downstream code scoring or cluster merging.

name: cluster-marker-gene-ranking
description: Use when scRNA-seq clusters (e.g. integrated HSPC clusters from SingCellaR) need systematic, gene-set-based cell type annotation rather than marker-gene eyeballing, and a curated GMT of lineage signatures is available.

name: cluster-marker-set-interpretation
description: Use when a scdrake pipeline run has produced per-cluster marker-gene tables and you need downstream biological interpretation of those marker sets via gene set enrichment (GO/KEGG) rather than plain marker lists.

name: cluster-marker-signature-extraction
description: Use when you have a TPM/CPM-normalized reference gene expression matrix with known cluster labels and need cluster-specific marker gene sets (e.g., via find_markers with logFC 0.6) to score or map target cells.

name: cluster-mean-subpopulation-profiling
description: Use when scRNA-seq (E) and scATAC-seq (O) matrices from the same heterogeneous population already carry cell-cluster labels and a bulk data type (e.g., HiChIP loop counts) must be seeded with per-cluster mean profiles before deconvolution.

name: cluster-membership-argmax-thresholding
description: Use when a source-regularized NMF has produced soft cluster coefficients W_trg for target cells and the transfer-learning construction of X_trg_new requires hard one-hot cluster memberships per cell.

name: cluster-membership-permutation-testing
description: Use when a SINCERA clustering run (hierarchical average/ward linkage, consensus, or tight clustering) on z-scored cell type-selective genes needs a significance check before cell type labels are finalized.

name: cluster-membership-table-export
description: Use when you have a candidate L-R pair expression-change matrix from dsCellNet's developcorrelation DTW step for a developmental series (e.g. GSE153164 corticogenesis) and need to partition L-R pairs into time-point-specific clusters and write out per-cluster gene lists.

name: cluster-membership-threshold-filtering
description: Use when temporal expression changes of candidate interactions (e.g., L-R pairs) must be partitioned into soft clusters and only high-confidence core members of each cluster are needed to call peak time points.

name: cluster-merge-significance-testing
description: Use when scRNA-seq data is log-cpm normalised with high-resolution Leiden over-clusters and you must decide which clusters are significantly different versus which should be merged.

name: cluster-metric-computation-ami-ari
description: Use when you need to quantify how well predicted single-cell profiles (e.g., ADT from consecutive epigenome→transcriptome→proteome translation) preserve cell-type structure, comparing methods via AMI/ARI/HOM/NMI.

name: cluster-number-estimation
description: Use when clustering scRNA-seq data where the true number of cell types is unknown, or when benchmarking how accurately clustering methods (e.g., CASCC vs. SC3) recover K against annotated ground-truth cell-type labels.

name: cluster-number-inflection-detection
description: Use when tuning the α parameter of hybrid clone/transcriptome clustering (e.g., ClonoCluster) and you need a data-driven cutoff for how much clone information can be injected before cluster number balloons beyond the transcriptome-only baseline.

name: cluster-number-selection-elbow-silhouette
description: Use when clustering PCA-reduced single-cell expression data (e.g., scSPARKL-normalized wide-format matrices in Parquet/CSV) and you need to justify k via elbow (WCSS) and silhouette criteria before downstream per-cluster DGE t-tests.

name: cluster-overexpressed-gene-identification
description: Use when a scRNA-seq dataset has annotated cell clusters (e.g., Seurat Louvain clusters) and you need per-cluster overexpressed genes to feed NicheNet-style ligand-receptor interaction scoring between sender and receiver clusters.

name: cluster-pair-interaction-score-plotting
description: Use when pre-computed ligand-receptor interactions (CCI data) need to be filtered to specific genes and cluster-pairs and visualized as interaction-score dot plots across multiple datasets/conditions, e.g. to test whether a communication pattern is disease-specific.

name: cluster-pairwise-differential-expression
description: Use when preprocessing scRNA-seq clusters for automatic cell type annotation and you need cluster marker genes free of pseudo markers from one-against-all testing.

name: cluster-probability-distribution-handling
description: Use when sample-level distances between single-cell or pathomics samples must be computed from cell-cluster compositions, and each sample needs a normalized cluster-distribution vector (marginal) for optimal transport.

name: cluster-proportion-comparison
description: Use when synthetic scRNA-seq data generated from pilot sub-samples (e.g., PBMC4k or Segerstolpe) must be checked for whether cluster/cell-type proportions match ground-truth proportions, and how this improves with pilot size.

name: cluster-proportion-spatial-visualization
description: Use when a spatial transcriptomics dataset (e.g., ST spots with x-delimited coordinate column names) has been deconvolved via an OT plan into per-spot cluster proportions, and you need spatial pie-chart and cluster-expression maps.

name: cluster-pruning-merging-expansion
description: Use when propagating seed labels over a directed kNN graph and the resulting clusters need pruning of tiny clusters, merging of similar clusters, and assignment of remaining unlabeled cells without a predetermined cluster count.

name: cluster-purity-cell-informativeness-classification
description: Use when after filtering a healthy/reference signal from case (e.g. COVID-19 PBMC) cells with SiFT, you must identify which single cells carry disease-related dynamics and which subpopulations they belong to.

name: cluster-purity-quantification
description: Use when a scRNA-seq clustering partition must be judged for homogeneity — e.g. to decide whether a cluster needs re-clustering, to verify purity of identified subtypes (ROGUE > 0.92 threshold), or to assess purity loss from batch aggregation.

name: cluster-purity-quantification-via-shannon-index
description: Use when labeled single-cell data (e.g. FACS-sorted subsets) must be partitioned into landmarks or reference clusters, and the number of clusters k must be chosen objectively from a purity-versus-k curve.

name: cluster-purity-score-computation
description: Use when you have predicted cluster labels plus reference labels used for data generation and need a single score per method to rank clustering performance, e.g., benchmarking on synthetic ring/half-moon data.

name: cluster-purity-score-computation
description: Use when CITE-seq clusters have been produced (e.g., by LinQ-View joint, RNA-only, or ADT-only Louvain clustering) and you need a quantitative purity value per cluster in each modality to compare clustering quality.

name: cluster-purity-statistic-derivation
description: Use when you need a quantitative purity score for an identified scRNA-seq cell cluster — e.g. to decide whether to re-cluster — from a gene-by-cell UMI count matrix annotated with a platform (droplet or full-length).

name: cluster-rank-selection-via-cpcc-dispersion
description: Use when running NMF (or similar consensus clustering) on a candidate-regulator feature matrix and you must justify the chosen cluster count via consensus-based stability indices like CPCC and dispersion.

name: cluster-reconstruction-quality-metrics
description: Use when evaluating which clusters detected by a reference clustering (e.g. griph on FACS-purified PBMC setA log10 counts) can be functionally reconstructed by a TF/miRNA/kinase-biased autoencoder latent space.

name: cluster-separation-quality-assessment
description: Use when you have 2D UMAP coordinates plus cell-type labels (e.g., from Seurat KNN graph clustering on 10 PCs) and need a numeric, per-sample measure of cluster separation to compare across feature spaces such as gene, aTAR, and uTAR expression.

name: cluster-separation-visual-assessment
description: Use when you must visually compare whether one similarity-learning method (e.g., SSRE) separates known cell types/stages in 2D more clearly than competing methods, using the same embedding procedure across all methods.

name: cluster-signature-radar-visualization
description: Use when single-cell clusters (e.g., CD8 TIL states) need to be summarized as quantitative phenotypic axes from curated marker signatures, with a compact radar-chart comparison across clusters.

name: cluster-significance-area-interpretation
description: Use when SCA/SSCA runs on scRNAseq clusters (e.g. setA clusters 1-5) have produced QCM/QCC values and you must decide which clusters are significantly reconstructed and compare latent-space combinations.

name: cluster-size-distribution-comparison
description: Use when comparing imputation-plus-clustering pipelines on labeled scRNA-seq data and ARI/NMI alone is insufficient — e.g., checking whether predicted per-cluster cell counts match true cell-type proportions (Quake_10x_Spleen: scGCL ARI 0.94 / NMI 0.87).

name: cluster-size-filtering
description: Use when you have run Totem's k-medoids (CLARA) clustering many times (default 10,000 runs, k = 3-20) on a low-dimensional embedding and must drop runs that contain clusters with fewer than five cells.

name: cluster-size-read-fraction-statistics
description: Use when FASTQ-to-SAM UMI pipelines have produced per-position UMI cluster data for one or more UMI-based RNA-Seq datasets and you need to quantify what proportion of reads fall into size-1 clusters versus mapping-shifted clusters.

name: cluster-specific-differential-expression-analysis
description: Use when an scRNA-seq dataset has already been QC-filtered, normalized, scaled, and partitioned into Louvain clusters (e.g. PBMC3k via Seurat/SCALA), and per-cluster marker genes ranked by log2FC are needed.

name: cluster-specific-gene-signature-extraction
description: Use when a library-depth-normalized reference scRNA-seq matrix (genes x cells) with cluster labels is available and you need per-cluster marker gene signatures (e.g. logFC >= 0.6) to feed scid_multiclass for cross-dataset cell type mapping.

name: cluster-specificity-curve-analysis
description: Use when a preprocessed Seurat scRNA-seq object must be clustered at an unknown resolution and you need an objective, marker-specificity-based criterion (rather than eyeballing) to pick the configuration that yields the most specific cluster markers before cell-type annotation.

name: cluster-stability-quantification
description: Use when clustering transcriptomic (bulk or single-cell) data with an unknown number of clusters and you must algorithmically determine the optimal k and decide when to stop recursive subdivision.

name: cluster-stability-scoring
description: Use when multiple conflicting cell-cluster annotations (e.g. Leiden at resolutions 1/2/3, Seurat3, Monocle3, ICGS2, cellHarmony, Azimuth label transfer) exist for the same cells and each cluster's stability must be scored before reconciliation.

name: cluster-subtype-correspondence-mapping
description: Use when samples have both an unsupervised grouping (e.g., hierarchical clustering over rROMA pathway activity scores) and independent clinical/molecular subtype labels (e.g., PAM50), and you need to establish or validate the cluster-to-subtype correspondence.

name: cluster-to-reference-signature-mapping
description: Use when you have clusters of rare cells detected de novo (e.g. from FiRE + dropClust) and a published reference signature (e.g. Villani dendritic sub-types) to which you must assign identities via differential gene overlap.

name: cluster-treatment-enrichment-testing
description: Use when a semi-supervised clustering run (e.g. ICAT's 'sslouvain' labels on perturbed scRNA-seq cells) must be checked for whether specific treatments are over-represented in specific clusters, as in the sea urchin PMC Fig 5A analysis.

name: cluster-wise-cell-type-annotation
description: Use when a clustered scRNA-seq object (scanpyobj.h5ad) needs cell type labels per cluster, or when a bulk deconvolution reference cell line must be chosen from the eight supported LINCS lines.

name: cluster-wise-dynamical-model-fitting
description: Use when you have a single-cell transcriptomics dataset with cluster labels, a gene-gene regulatory mask (e.g. ATAC-seq-derived), and coexpression/manifold priors, and you need cluster-specific GRN interaction matrices plus per-cell velocity vectors.

name: cluster-wise-single-cell-subsampling
description: Use when constructing cell-type-specific gene regulatory networks from untreated scRNA-seq expression profiles and single full-cluster inference would be unstable — i.e., when subsampled PCR fits must be aggregated across clusters before in silico drug-perturbation ranking.

name: clustering-accuracy-agreement-scoring
description: Use when you must rank pipeline configurations (e.g., integration method × cost-matrix similarity metric such as Cosine vs. Euclidean) by how well their sample-level clusters or trajectory orderings agree with true disease-status labels.

name: clustering-accuracy-ari-evaluation
description: Use when comparing dimension-reduction embeddings (e.g., CA variants, PCA, glmPCA) on labeled scRNA-seq benchmarks and you need a single cluster-recovery score per method per dataset.

name: clustering-accuracy-ari-evaluation-against-true-labels
description: Use when a simulation or labeled benchmark provides known cell-type labels and you must quantify how accurately a clustering (e.g., BUSseq celltypes()) recovers them, e.g., expecting ARI=1.0 at the true K.

name: clustering-accuracy-assessment
description: Use when simulated count data has known ground-truth co-expression or temporal pattern labels and you must quantify how faithfully a clustering method (k-means) recovers those patterns.

name: clustering-accuracy-benchmark-comparison
description: Use when a scRNA-Seq dataset has known per-cell labels (e.g. tumor of origin MGH26-MGH31, cell type, replicate) and you must quantify whether a correction method such as ccRemover or scLVM improves cluster-vs-label agreement over uncorrected data.

name: clustering-accuracy-benchmarking-ari-nmi
description: Use when you need to quantify whether an enhanced or refined clustering (e.g. scAce applied to Seurat/CIDR initial labels) improves clustering accuracy on scRNA-seq data, scored via ARI and NMI.

name: clustering-accuracy-evaluation-ari-purity
description: Use when a produced set of cluster_labels must be scored against reference cell-type labels (e.g., PBMC CITE-seq/multiome marker-gene labels) via ARI and purity, and when quantifying ARI improvement from posterior-probability label filtering.

name: clustering-accuracy-evaluation-with-known-labels
description: Use when clustering results on datasets with known cell-type or class labels (e.g. mass cytometry benchmarks or simulated data with ground truth) must be quantitatively scored by ARI, NMI and accuracy for method comparison.

name: clustering-accuracy-metric-computation
description: Use when cluster assignments produced from multimodal single-cell embeddings must be scored against reference cell-type labels (e.g. CITE-seq RNA/ADT data) to compare clustering algorithms or settings such as ensemble size.

name: clustering-accuracy-metric-computation
description: Use when a JOINTLY (or competing integration method) clustering must be quantitatively scored against known cell type labels, e.g. benchmark ARI/NMI tables or rank aggregation across integration tasks.

name: clustering-accuracy-metrics-ari-vi
description: Use when comparing cell-labeling methods that map target scRNA-seq/snRNA-seq cells to reference clusters and you need per-method coverage plus ARI/VI accuracy rankings against known cluster identities.

name: clustering-accuracy-nmi-ari-evaluation
description: Use when cluster assignments from one or more clustering algorithms must be scored against known ground-truth cell labels, to produce a comparable accuracy/NMI/ARI benchmark table across methods.

name: clustering-accuracy-nmi-evaluation
description: Use when predicted cluster assignments from an scRNA-seq clustering run (e.g., SC3, Seurat, SIMLR, k-means under SCC/SSCC) must be scored against known cell-type labels, or when consistency between two subsampling rates must be measured.

name: clustering-agreement-ari-evaluation
description: Use when benchmarking a co-expression or clustering method on simulated data with known latent gene clusters (e.g., four co-expressed clusters, n=2000 cells, p=100 genes) and you need ARI of cluster recovery plus PCA subspace agreement per method.

name: clustering-agreement-ari-nmi-evaluation
description: Use when you have a per-cell TE count matrix (locus-level or subfamily-level) from MATES and need to validate quantification quality via clustering agreement (ARI/NMI) with gene-based clustering or via ARI improvement tests.

name: clustering-agreement-evaluation-with-ari
description: Use when two or more clustering partitions (from RCC, ConsensusClusterPlus, or other methods like k-means, hierarchical clustering, pam, mclust) must be quantitatively compared against a reference to decide which parameterization (e.g., repeats, parallel processes, pItem/pFeature settings) agrees .

name: clustering-agreement-metric-computation
description: Use when benchmarking imputed versus raw scRNA-seq expression matrices: after clustering cells, you need ARI, Jaccard, NMI, and purity against known cell type labels to compare clustering accuracy across methods.

name: clustering-agreement-metric-computation
description: Use when comparing cell-type label assignments (e.g., MASI alone vs SCCAF vs SCCAF+MASI) against published annotations on an scRNA-seq query dataset, or when sweeping a certainty-score threshold to recover unseen cell types.

name: clustering-agreement-metric-computation
description: Use when you need to score clustering quality of 2D/low-dimensional embeddings (e.g., from VASC) against known cell-type labels, or to compare score distributions across repeated stochastic runs (e.g., with vs. without a ZI layer).

name: clustering-agreement-metric-computation
description: Use when you have predicted cluster labels and reference cell-type labels for the same cells and need per-dataset, per-method ARI/AMI/NMI scores for a clustering benchmark comparison.

name: clustering-agreement-metrics-ari-nmi
description: Use when predicted cluster labels (e.g., from scEFSC, scDHA, SC3, Seurat) must be quantitatively scored against published cell-type labels of a scRNA-seq dataset to compare clustering methods by ARI and NMI.

name: clustering-agreement-metrics-ari-nmi
description: Use when comparing cluster assignments from KMeans (random_state=1) on raw or imputed scRNA-Seq data against known cell-type labels to quantify whether imputation (e.g., AutoClassImpute) improves clustering (ARI, JI, NMI, purity).

name: clustering-agreement-metrics-homogeneity-completeness-vmeasure
description: Use when two or more single-cell clustering solutions (or one solution plus a reference atlas annotation like Azimuth L2) must be compared quantitatively to determine which recovers known cell populations.

name: clustering-ari-agreement-evaluation
description: Use when an ICAT run (control Louvain → NCFS upweighting → semi-supervised Louvain) has produced `sslouvain` assignments and you must quantify recovery against simulated ground-truth `Population` labels via adjusted Rand index.

name: clustering-ari-evaluation
description: Use when a clustering result on single-cell RNA-seq data must be quantitatively validated against known cell-type labels, e.g., comparing DESC vs MNN/scVI/BERMUDA/Scanorama on the combined Fluidigm C1, SMART-seq2, CEL-seq, and CEL-seq2 islet data.

name: clustering-ari-evaluation
description: Use when comparing clustering-based cell type identification (Seurat, SC3) against a supervised annotator on scRNA-seq data with known true labels, and you need ARI as the comparable metric across training/test size conditions.

name: clustering-based-rare-cell-detection
description: Use when the input is a raw scRNA-seq count matrix (genes in columns, cells in rows) and the goal is to detect rare cell populations (e.g., <1% of cells) that standard one-time clustering pipelines like Seurat tend to miss.

name: clustering-benchmark-across-datasets
description: Use when you need to demonstrate that an unsupervised clustering method yields consistent cluster counts and concordant assignments across repeated runs and across multiple bulk or single-cell transcriptome datasets.

name: clustering-benchmark-against-author-annotations
description: Use when evaluating a proposed clustering/annotation strategy against an author-curated clustering on a published scRNA-seq dataset (e.g. reproducing a paper's resolution-selection criterion on a reference atlas with known sub_cluster labels).

name: clustering-benchmark-comparison
description: Use when a single-cell RNA-seq clustering method must be statistically compared against established baselines (e.g., Seurat, SC3, SIMLR) over a multi-dataset benchmark using ARI significance testing and embedding-quality metrics such as ASW.

name: clustering-benchmark-evaluation
description: Use when a new clustering method must be rigorously compared to competitors (e.g., PhenoGraph, HDBSCAN, Louvain/Leiden implementations) on simulated or biological datasets where ground-truth labels are available.

name: clustering-benchmark-evaluation
description: Use when a clustering method must be validated against baselines on datasets with known ground-truth labels (Splatter-simulated scRNA-seq, synthetic ring/half-moon/Gaussian-mixture shapes), and purity/ARI plus paired significance testing are needed.

name: clustering-benchmark-evaluation
description: Use when a new single-cell clustering or batch-correction method must be compared quantitatively against published baselines on multiple real scRNA-seq datasets with known cell-type labels.

name: clustering-benchmark-reproduction
description: Use when reproducing or validating the SSRE NMI/ARI clustering benchmark on Splatter-simulated scRNA-seq data, or when comparing a single-cell clustering method against published Tables S1-S2 scores.

name: clustering-center-initialization-kmeans-spectral
description: Use when training a deep embedding clustering model (e.g. scMGCA's graph convolutional autoencoder) where the self-optimizing KL clustering stage needs well-initialized cluster centers on latent embeddings of scRNA-seq data.

name: clustering-concordance-adjusted-rand-index
description: Use when independent cluster assignments of the same cells exist (e.g., CNA-derived and mutation-derived) and an orthogonal-validation metric is needed to confirm a caller's subclone structure.

name: clustering-concordance-metric-computation
description: Use when you need to quantitatively benchmark whether a feature-quantification method (e.g., MATES vs scTE/SoloTE) yields better downstream cell clustering, given known cell labels and repeated clusterings over multiple seeds.

name: clustering-consistency-metric-evaluation
description: Use when an imputation method (e.g., Bfimpute, scImpute, MAGIC, SAVER, VIPER, PBLR, DrImpute) must be benchmarked on data with known cell type labels, such as splatter-simulated matrices or labeled 10x datasets, to quantify clustering recovery.

name: clustering-diversity-filtering-with-ari
description: Use when combining multiple base clustering solutions (e.g. nine scRNA-seq algorithms on feature-selected scRNA-seq data) and redundant, highly similar label sets must be removed before meta-clustering.

name: clustering-enhancement-initialization
description: Use when you already have cluster assignments from another scRNA-seq clustering method (e.g. scDeepCluster, DESC, SCCAF, ADClust) on a preprocessed AnnData object and want scAce to update and enhance those assignments.

name: clustering-hyperparameter-grid-search
description: Use when evaluating a pretrained cell-embedding (e.g., tGPT feature representations) by clustering, and you must sweep KNN/Leiden hyperparameters before computing NMI, ARI, and FMI against known cell-type annotations.

name: clustering-index-benchmark-evaluation
description: Use when you have cross-modality translated profiles (e.g., A2R/R2A predictions from scButterfly test_model or baselines) on cell-type-disjoint test folds and need to quantify heterogeneity preservation via clustering indices.

name: clustering-method-benchmarking
description: Use when a single-cell gene expression matrix must be clustered and compared across multiple clustering methods, or when reproducing scAce's ARI/NMI benchmark (Fig. 2A simulated, Fig. 3A real).

name: clustering-method-variant-comparison
description: Use when scRNA-Seq cells must be assigned to clusters for cell type identification and no single clustering method can be trusted a priori; run four SINCERA clustering variants on the identical input and pick the scheme supported by permutation tests and selective marker expression.

name: clustering-metric-computation
description: Use when comparing cell-cluster assignments produced by two or more scRNA-seq clustering methods against ground-truth cell-type labels and need ARI, NMI and V-measure scores to rank methods.

name: clustering-metric-computation-ari-asw-kbet
description: Use when comparing batch-integration methods on annotated scRNA-seq AnnData with 'batch_indices' and 'cell_types' columns and you need quantitative ARI/ASW/kBET scores to judge biology preservation vs. batch over-correction.

name: clustering-metric-computation-ari-lisi-db
description: Use when comparing cell-state clustering quality of methods (e.g., ICAT vs Seurat/Scanorama/Harmony integration) on scRNA-seq perturbation datasets that have ground-truth cell labels and treatment conditions.

name: clustering-metric-computation-ari-nmi-vmeasure
description: Use when comparing clustering assignments of scRNA-seq cells against ground-truth labels (e.g., FACS-sorted CD4+/CD8+ T cells or Tabula Muris Senis cell types) and reporting ARI, NMI, and V-measure.

name: clustering-metric-computation-nmi-ari-asw
description: Use when evaluating predicted single-cell cluster assignments against ground-truth cell type labels, or comparing learned cell embeddings of scMGCA vs baselines (scziDesk, scDeepCluster, DCA, DEC, DESC, scVI, scCAEs, scGNN, scGAE, GraphSCC, Seurat, SHARP).

name: clustering-metric-computation-vs-true-labels
description: Use when scRNA-seq cell embeddings have been produced by scGCL or one of its ablation variants (task=clustering, epochs=300) and you need agreement metrics against ground-truth cell labels to compare variants across datasets like Adam and Romanov.

name: clustering-metric-evaluation-ari-nmi
description: Use when comparing clustering quality of translated cross-modality profiles (e.g., scButterfly-B vs scButterfly-T vs scButterfly-C on MCC scRNA–scATAC data) against true cell-type labels to quantify translation fidelity.

name: clustering-metric-evaluation-ari-silhouette
description: Use when imputed or denoised scRNA-Seq count matrices must be scored for cell-type recovery against known simulated groups (e.g., the six Splatter-simulated groups of Dataset 1) using ASW, ARI, MSE, and zero-recovery metrics.

name: clustering-metric-evaluation-nmi-ca-ari
description: Use when comparing clustering results (e.g., scDCC vs. SC3, CIDR, PhenoGraph, k-means) on labeled scRNA-seq data, or when verifying that added pairwise constraints actually improve NMI/CA/ARI.

name: clustering-parameter-sweep-evaluation
description: Use when you need to choose or characterize a weighting parameter for hybrid clone/transcriptome clustering by measuring chance-corrected agreement (Cohen's kappa) between clusters and clonal barcodes across a parameter range.

name: clustering-performance-benchmarking
description: Use when you need to quantify whether adding noisy pairwise constraints improves scRNA-seq clustering — e.g., testing robustness of scDCC to 5% or 10% mislabeled must-link/cannot-link constraints versus an unsupervised baseline.

name: clustering-performance-evaluation-ari-nmi
description: Use when you have per-cell cluster predictions from one or more single-cell clustering methods plus reference cell-type labels, and need to quantify and significance-test clustering accuracy (ARI/NMI).

name: clustering-performance-metric-computation
description: Use when evaluating scRNA-seq clustering outputs against known cell-type labels, especially when measuring how clustering quality (NMI, CA, ARI) changes as the number of pairwise must-link/cannot-link constraints increases.

name: clustering-performance-metric-visualization
description: Use when comparing clustering outputs (e.g., ICAT sslouvain assignments vs. Seurat/Scanorama/Harmony/no-integration Louvain) across simulated perturbation-severity, marker-gene-count, or cell-proportion conditions against known ground-truth labels.

name: clustering-performance-metrics-evaluation
description: Use when a multi-clustering integration result (scTriangulate clusters) must be quantitatively compared against silver-standard references or individual modality/resolution clustering solutions using V-Measure, Homogeneity, and Completeness.

name: clustering-quality-metric-computation
description: Use when comparing two or more cell-by-embedding matrices of the same single-cell dataset against identical cell-type labels — e.g., benchmarking a 137-GEP dimension reduction against PCA, scDHA, or scMGCA embeddings.

name: clustering-quality-metric-evaluation
description: Use when you have run SCA on a single-cell counts matrix (e.g., setA PBMC clusters 1-5) and need to judge which clusters the autoencoder encoding reliably reconstructs, especially clusters whose QCM/QCC scores sit near the 0.5 significance threshold.

name: clustering-quality-metric-tabulation
description: Decision support for evaluating whether synthetic single-cell RNA-seq data from small pilot studies preserve clustering structure — e.g., when comparing DBI/ARI variability of scDBM, scVI prior, scVI posterior, and noise baselines across pilot sizes or technologies.

name: clustering-result-reproducibility-checking
description: Use when a task requires re-running an unsupervised clustering pipeline (RCC) on published bulk RNA-seq matrices (e.g., Ivy GAP, GTEx, TCGA SKCM) to confirm that reported novel subtypes and cluster counts can be reproduced.

name: clustering-robustness-subset-resampling
description: Use when you need to quantify how sensitive a scRNA-seq clustering method is to cell subsampling: run each method on 10 random 95%-cell subsets, compute ARI/NMI per repeat against ground truth, and compare per-method medians.

name: clustering-seed-selection-strategy
description: Use when clustering single-cell (e.g., PBMC scRNA-seq) data on a KNN/adaptive-kernel affinity matrix and a deterministic, assumption-light label-propagation procedure is needed that guarantees every vertex receives exactly one cluster label without a predefined cluster count.

name: clustering-selection-criteria-ranking
description: Use when many candidate clusterings of a trajectory-containing single-cell dataset must be ranked and compared by selection criteria (connectivity+VRC, ASW, VRC, random) to pick clusterings for MST-based trajectory inference.

name: clustering-selection-for-trajectory-inference
description: Use when a Totem-style trajectory pipeline has produced thousands of candidate clusterings and you must automatically pick which clustering(s) to feed into Slingshot MST construction, rather than hand-picking a biologically sensible model.

name: clustering-silhouette-assessment
description: Use when integration quality of uniPort-embedded scATAC/scRNA (or other single-cell) datasets must be quantified by Silhouette plus ARI, NMI and F1 to compare modality-linking or cell-type-removal scenarios.

name: clustering-similarity-metric-computation
description: Use when benchmarking a dimensionality reduction or clustering variant on scRNA-seq embeddings and you need quantitative agreement scores (ECS, kNN-overlap) against ground-truth labels or a reference method's embedding.

name: clustering-stability-assessment
description: Use when comparing unsupervised clustering methods on droplet-based scRNA-seq data and you need perturbation-based stability (APN) and tightness (silhouette width) metrics, as in BAMM-SC benchmarking on human PBMC, mouse lung, and human skin datasets.

name: cmh-pvalue-comparison-across-encodings
description: Use when genotype data may have been binarized with the wrong encoding and you must decide whether HOGImine's additive-encoding mode better recovers the planted phenotype association than binary-encoding mode.

name: cmh-pvalue-significance-benchmarking
description: Use when comparing the statistical power of significant-pattern mining methods (e.g. HOGImine vs SiNIMin vs FastCMH) on synthetic binary genotype data, where the goal is to count significant patterns or extract minimum CMH p-values per method under a fixed FWER such as 0.05.

name: cmh-significance-interpretation
description: Use when comparing significant meta-marker/interval outputs from CMH-based miners (HOGImine, SiNIMin, FastCMH) on the same binary-encoded biobank, or benchmarking their runtimes across sample counts n and SNPs-per-gene l.

name: cmh-test-conditional-association-scoring
description: Use when samples carry a categorical covariate (e.g. country of origin) and you must test SNP-interval patterns for binary phenotype association while controlling FWER via Tarone's method, as in HOGImine/FastCMH-style mining.

name: cmh-test-family-wise-error-control
description: Use when discovering combinations of genetic markers (meta-markers) associated with a binary phenotype and the number of tested patterns is large enough that raw CMH p-values would inflate family-wise error; supports conditioning on covariate classes.

name: cms-classifier-benchmark-comparison
description: Use when comparing a trained CMS/DeepCC classifier against baseline machine-learning classifiers on independent CRC expression validation sets, or when reporting per-dataset sensitivity/specificity/accuracy with paired significance tests.

name: cms-prediction-template-generation
description: Use when CMS-classifying pre-clinical CRC expression data (PDX, cell lines, organoids) and you need to derive NTP templates or assess how robust CMScaller assignments are to template-derivation thresholds and marker-selection choices.

name: cms-subtype-drug-association-testing
description: Use when cell line, PDX, or organoid models already have CMScaller CMS labels and per-model drug response values (e.g. 5-FU IC50), and you want to test whether subtype predicts drug sensitivity independently of MSI status.

name: cms-subtype-fraction-tabulation
description: Use when CMS class assignments from CMScaller (or classifyCMS.RF) must be summarized as per-dataset subtype fractions across pre-clinical CRC datasets to verify subtype representation.

name: cms-subtype-label-joining
description: Use when you have gene expression data from CRC pre-clinical models (PDXs, organoids, cell lines) plus drug-response annotations, and need to test whether a CMS subtype (e.g. CMS2) predicts response, as with cetuximab in Gao PDXs and Medle/Binter cell lines.

name: cms-subtype-molecular-association-analysis
description: Use when CMS subtype calls from CMScaller must be cross-validated against per-sample molecular features (MSI/MSS status, mutation counts, BRAF status, CNA burden) to confirm biologically expected subtype associations.

name: cna-based-aml-cell-classification
description: Use when a scRNA-seq sample has known eWGS-discovered CNA events (e.g. 1p/7q losses in AML) and you need per-cell tumor/normal labels from copy number, or want to validate SNV-based cell calls against a CNA-based ground truth.

name: cna-benchmark-evaluation-against-scdna-ground-truth
description: Use when comparing CNA callers on the same snRNA-seq sample where a single-cell DNA copy-number profile exists for a clonal subset, and per-cell copy gain/loss sensitivity–specificity (ROC-AUC) is the evaluation metric.

name: cna-probability-kmeans-clone-clustering
description: Use when scRNA-seq (10x Genomics or Smart-seq2) of a tumour sample has been processed by XClone's RDR+BAF+Combine modules and per-cell clone labels are needed from the resulting CNA probability tensor.

name: cndm-normalization-single-cell-network
description: Use when a c-CSN-transformed conditional network degree matrix (CNDM) must be normalized for compatibility with Seurat, t-SNE, SC3, or SIMLR clustering, e.g., to reproduce ARI = 0.73 on Tabula Muris droplet1 (GSE109774).

name: cnmf-geneset-feature-selection
description: Use when building a ProjectSVR reference model or projecting query cells and you must define gene-set features — e.g. choosing cNMF programs (K selection such as K=70 for mTCA) or top-25 marker sets per cell type.

name: cnn-architecture-construction-for-rna-classification
description: Use when a tissue-specific RNA m6A classifier must be built from 41-nt one-hot encoded sequences (164-dimensional vectors) in Keras/TensorFlow 2.0, e.g., reproducing im6A-TS-CNN model construction for one of the 11 species-tissue benchmarks.

name: cnn-embedding-layer-design
description: Use when building or re-instantiating a transformer basecaller that must project STFT spectrogram-like inputs of ONT dRNA current chunks into per-frame embeddings before attention encoder modules.

name: cnn-model-performance-evaluation
description: Use when benchmarking a deep learning classifier on RNA modification-site prediction data across balanced and imbalanced regimes and you need per-fold averaged metrics comparable to published baselines.

name: cnn-model-training-for-rna-modification-prediction
description: Use when binary-classifying RNA modification sites from uridine-centered sequence fragments plus predicted secondary structure, or when reproducing/ablation-testing sequence-only vs structure-only CNN baselines.

name: cnn-sequence-model-training
description: Use when a candidate list of polyA/IPA sites must be scored purely from nucleotide sequence context, or when a CNN classifier for polyA sites must be trained and benchmarked with AUROC.

name: cnn-training-early-stopping
description: Use when training a CNN classifier on one-hot encoded nucleotide sequences (e.g., 41-nt m6A windows) and you need a stable training regime with 5-fold cross-validation and early stopping.

name: cnv-based-malignancy-calling-benchmarking
description: Use when a scRNA-seq dataset requires distinguishing malignant from non-malignant cells and you must decide between marker-based aberrant annotation and CNV-based callers (SCEVAN, CopyKAT), or quantify their accuracy and runtime trade-offs.

name: cnv-based-phylogenetic-clustering
description: Use when scRNA-seq data (e.g., the 430-cell single-cell GBM dataset) require reconstruction of a CNV-based clonal tree and testing of mutually exclusive vs co-occurring subclone CNV events across cells.

name: cnv-calling-from-bulk-rna-seq
description: Use when normalized bulk RNA-seq expression matrices (with optional BAF shift files) must be mined for chromosome-arm, segment, and gene-level CNV events, or when RNA-derived CNV calls need TPR/FPR benchmarking against genotyping-array calls.

name: cnv-clustered-heatmap-visualization
description: Use when you have a cell-annotated cancer scRNA-seq object (e.g., Seurat object from scWizard annotation) and need to identify malignant cells by copy-number alteration and display them in a clustered inferCNV heatmap.

name: cnv-covariate-sensitivity-check
description: Use when SSrGE eeSNV/gene rankings from scRNA-seq (e.g., Patel, Ting, Kim, Miyamoto cancer datasets) need a sensitivity check against copy-number variation as an additional predictor.

name: cnv-heatmap-and-oncoprint-interpretation
description: Use when SCEVAN (pipelineCNA with SUBCLONES=TRUE) has produced heatmap/clone-tree/OncoPrint outputs for a scRNA-seq tumor sample and you must interpret truncal vs. shared vs. subclone-specific CNAs and verify them against published profiles.

name: cnv-mtdna-clone-confusion-analysis
description: Use when single-cell data have both mtDNA-variant clone labels (e.g., from vireoSNP on MQuad SNPs) and CNV-based clone labels (e.g., CellRanger/VireoSNP BAF clustering) and you need to quantify concordance or finer subclonal resolution.

name: co-clustering-frequency-tabulation
description: Use when building a fixed transcriptional module repertoire from multiple gene expression cohorts, by quantifying cross-dataset co-clustering of transcripts over shared profiles.

name: co-dependency-index-differential-expression
description: Use when scRNA-seq cluster markers must be cluster-specific (binary) DEGs — e.g. to detect genes exclusive to one sub_cluster population — or when comparing CDI against standard DE methods like Wilcoxon on DEG counts and specificity.

name: co-expression-attractor-feature-selection
description: Use when clustering scRNA-seq data (normalized, log-transformed expression matrix of genes x cells) and you want biologically meaningful co-expression-derived features (e.g. attractor gene sets seeded by markers like AIF1) to feed clustering rather than raw or PCA-only features.

name: co-expression-estimation-bias-curve-generation
